t: The Brenner 1 Ltr Kitchen Degreaser is a professional-grade degreaser designed to remove stubborn grease and grime from hard surfaces. This ready-to-use, fragrance-free formula is ideal for busy commercial kitchens, food preparation areas, and catering environments. It provides rapid action on daily splashes, spills, and sticky residues, allowing tradespeople to complete cleaning tasks quickly and efficiently. This spray bottle ensures clean, residue-free worktops without leaving chemical odours behind.
